_readme: One object per event. date is YYYY-MM-DD and times are 24-hour HH:MM in Windsor time (Eastern). type must be practice, contest or workshop. kattisUrl is optional: delete the line if there is no link. Events move from Upcoming to Past on their own once they end. SAMPLE DATA: replace before launch.

events.title: Kickoff + First Practice
events.description: Meet the execs, set up your Kattis account, and solve your first problems together.

events.title: Workshop: Complexity and Big-O
events.description: Why some solutions get Time Limit Exceeded, and how to estimate whether yours will pass before you submit.

events.title: Fall Club Contest #1
events.description: Three hours, eight problems, teams of up to three. Pizza after.

events.title: Weekly Practice: Graphs
events.description: BFS, DFS and connected components on a set of Kattis problems.

events.title: Weekly Practice: Binary Search
events.description: Binary search on arrays and on the answer. Bring a laptop.

events.title: Workshop: Intro to Dynamic Programming
events.description: From recursion to memoization to tables: knapsack, coin change and longest increasing subsequence.

events.title: Winter Club Contest #2
events.description: ICPC-style rules: teams of three sharing one computer. A good warm-up for the regional.

events.title: Weekly Practice: Greedy Algorithms
events.description: When is the obvious choice the right one? Exchange arguments and classic greedy problems.
